package appsinterface

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/internal/plugin/appsinterface/contract"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/pkg/rsiplugin"
	"strings"
)

func presentationLocale(call rsiplugin.Call) (string, error) {
	var request contract.LocaleRequest
	if err := rsiplugin.Decode(call.Input, &request); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if request.Locale != "en" && request.Locale != "zh-CN" {
		return "", errors.New("unsupported Apps locale")
	}
	return request.Locale, nil
}
func localizedText(locale, text string) string {
	if locale != "zh-CN" {
		return text
	}
	key := strings.TrimSpace(text)
	if value, ok := chineseText[key]; ok {
		return strings.Replace(text, key, value, 1)
	}
	return text
}
func compileLocalizedProfile(ctx context.Context, call rsiplugin.Call) (rsiplugin.Result, error) {
	locale, err := presentationLocale(call)
	if err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	p := profile()
	for i := range p.Accounts {
		p.Accounts[i].StatusLabel = localizedText(locale, p.Accounts[i].StatusLabel)
	}
	for i := range p.Cards {
		p.Cards[i].FirstLabel = localizedText(locale, p.Cards[i].FirstLabel)
	}
	for i := range p.Errors {
		p.Errors[i] = localizedText(locale, p.Errors[i])
	}
	p.Notices.AccountSaved = localizedText(locale, p.Notices.AccountSaved)
	p.Notices.ServiceSaved = localizedText(locale, p.Notices.ServiceSaved)
	p.Notices.Unsaved = localizedText(locale, p.Notices.Unsaved)
	p.Browser.Messages.OpenAuthorization = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.OpenAuthorization)
	p.Browser.Messages.DetailsFailed = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.DetailsFailed)
	p.Browser.Messages.ConnectionUnknown = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.ConnectionUnknown)
	p.Browser.Messages.PollPaused = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.PollPaused)
	p.Browser.Messages.PollFailed = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.PollFailed)
	p.Browser.Messages.AuthorizationFailed = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.AuthorizationFailed)
	p.Browser.Messages.AuthorizationOpened = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.AuthorizationOpened)
	p.Browser.Messages.PopupBlocked = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.PopupBlocked)
	p.Browser.Messages.LinkExpired = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.Messages.LinkExpired)

	for i := range p.Browser.PollNotices {
		p.Browser.PollNotices[i].Text = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.PollNotices[i].Text)
	}
	for i := range p.Browser.SuccessNotices {
		p.Browser.SuccessNotices[i] = localizedText(locale, p.Browser.SuccessNotices[i])
	}
	return rsiplugin.JSONResult(ctx, p)
}
func compileLocalizedComposition(ctx context.Context, call rsiplugin.Call) (rsiplugin.Result, error) {
	locale, err := presentationLocale(call)
	if err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	c := composition()
	c.Copy.AppsTitle = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AppsTitle)
	c.Copy.AppSettings = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AppSettings)
	c.Copy.SearchApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.SearchApps)
	c.Copy.Search = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.Search)
	c.Copy.RefreshApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.RefreshApps)
	c.Copy.DirectoryUnavailable = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.DirectoryUnavailable)
	c.Copy.BackToApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.BackToApps)
	c.Copy.AppViews = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AppViews)
	c.Copy.Discover = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.Discover)
	c.Copy.YourApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.YourApps)
	c.Copy.AllApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AllApps)
	c.Copy.Category = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.Category)
	c.Copy.AllCategories = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AllCategories)
	c.Copy.Filter = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.Filter)
	c.Copy.ViewAll = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ViewAll)
	c.Copy.ManageApp = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ManageApp)
	c.Copy.AboutApp = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AboutApp)
	c.Copy.NoApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.NoApps)
	c.Copy.MoreApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.MoreApps)
	c.Copy.ConnectionsUnavailable = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ConnectionsUnavailable)
	c.Copy.YourConnections = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.YourConnections)
	c.Copy.NoConnections = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.NoConnections)
	c.Copy.AddAccount = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AddAccount)
	c.Copy.ServiceTitle = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ServiceTitle)
	c.Copy.ProjectTitle = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ProjectTitle)
	c.Copy.ProjectHelp = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ProjectHelp)
	c.Copy.AuthenticationTitle = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.AuthenticationTitle)
	c.Copy.ConnectedApps = localizedText(locale, c.Copy.ConnectedApps)

	return rsiplugin.JSONResult(ctx, c)
}
